sections.title: Regional IRPEF surcharge 2026 (Piedmont)

source.title: MEF Dipartimento delle Finanze: Addizionale regionale all'IRPEF, aliquote applicabili 2026, REGIONE PIEMONTE (published 2026-01-29)

sections.basis: IRPEF taxable income, per year (bands as published by MEF; see the special rules)
sections.note: Rates apply to each band of income.

rows.label: Special rules (disposizioni particolari)
rows.value: 2026 credits: €100 per child for taxpayers with more than two dependent children (counted from the first child); €500 per dependent child with a disability (Law 104/1992).
